description: This file is a shell script for testing git merge behaviors. It contains test setup commands and multiple test cases to verify how git handles various file conflict scenarios during merges, including untracked files, staged changes, renamed files, untracked subtrees, symlinks, and unborn branch states.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path is missing from the filesystem.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Grep command to check for specific text in output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after tests.
